description: A small white AirPods charging case sits on a pink bed sheet with a white charging cable nearby. The right hand reaches in from the right to grasp the case as the left hand moves in to pinch the cable connector; with the case held steady as a right-hand object, the left hand pulls the connector out to unplug it, then the right hand slides the case upward and releases it near the back while the left hand lets the cable rest on the sheet.
